prompt: Who was the Vice Admiral in charge of the Carrier Division the Japanese carrier Hiyō was in when she was sunk?
answer:
Hiyō was part of the **2nd Carrier Division**, commanded by **Rear Admiral Takatsugu Jōjima (also spelled Joshima)** when she sank on June 20, 1944.  

The **Vice Admiral in overall command** of the Japanese Mobile Fleet was **Jisaburō Ozawa**.
